title: Inspect and extend: Connect the app shell to repository and issue screens
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/githubContext.tsx` to demonstrate and safely improve context lifecycle, tabs, profile/repository/issue states, and reusable controls.
problem: The shell selects a screen while context provides shared API and cache state. Follow a tap from navigation through state into the rendered list and profile. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/githubContext.tsx` and the related project files: App.tsx; src/githubContext.tsx; src/screens/ReposScreen.tsx; src/screens/IssuesScreen.tsx; src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx; src/components.tsx; src/theme.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to context lifecycle, tabs, profile/repository/issue states, and reusable controls.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The UI does not reproduce every capability or policy of the upstream GitPoint app.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: The shell selects a screen while context provides shared API and cache state. Follow a tap from navigation through state into the rendered list and profile.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/githubContext.tsx`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
